name: Naruto [Mid-Autumn Festival]
balanceNote: All damaging attacks use buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. Gamatatsu is the original summoned skill actor, not a separate autonomous combat unit. Unspecified coefficients, Knockdown chance, Defense penetration and modified chase bonuses are explicit local balance values. Excited Mode gives nonstacking 60% Physical ATK and reduces Physical DEF/Resistance by 30% for the current round; the original Ninjutsu bonus is replaced by Physical ATK.

mystery.name: Festival Wish - Ingot Shower from All Directions
mystery.description: Causes unavoidable damage and 5 Combo to all units in the opponent's field. Cooldown 1; Battlefield Cooldown 0; Chakra Cost 40.

standard.name: Summoning Jutsu - Gamatatsu
standard.description: Attacks 2-4 units in the opponent's lineup with a chance of causing Knockdown.

standard2.name: Summoning Jutsu - Gamatatsu
standard2.description: Attacks 2-4 units in the opponent's lineup with a chance of causing Knockdown.

standard3.name: Summoning Jutsu - Gamatatsu
standard3.description: Attacks 2-4 units in the opponent's lineup with a chance of causing Knockdown.

shower.name: Festival Wish - Ingot Shower
shower.description: At the beginning of every round, a random ninja in your lineup will receive Excited Mode and have their Combo Rate increased by 70% until the end of the round. Excited Mode: Physical ATK +60%, Physical DEF and Resistance -30% (not stackable).

chase.name: Festival Wish - Giant Coin Toss
chase.description: Triggered with at least 5 Combo, causes damage to up to 5 units in the opponent's lineup. This skill ignores a small amount of Defense. If Naruto's HP is higher than 60%, this skill is modified.

modified.name: Modified Festival Wish - Giant Coin Toss
modified.description: Triggered with at least 5 Combo, causes unavoidable damage to 1 unit in the opponent's lineup. This skill ignores a certain amount of Defense and has additional Critical Rate and Injury Rate.

passives.name: Festival Wish - The Moon Rabbit and The Toad King
passives.description: Naruto is immune to Debuffs. Whenever Naruto executes his Standard Attack, increases his Physical ATK by 4% (stackable). Whenever Naruto executes Festival Wish - Ingot Shower, all ally non-ninja units will receive an Extra Standard Attack.
